requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text: 每秒串口输出 A0 电位器值 和 D2 按钮状态
requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: Apply arbitrary sequences to io_0 (f64) and io_1 (bool) while driving io_2 with 1000ms total elapsed time across control steps; repeat for at least two seconds (e.g., first second then second second).
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: serial_0_trigger becomes true on the once-per-1000ms boundary (first step where accumulatedMs reaches/exceeds 1000, then repeats each subsequent 1000ms). When serial_0_trigger is true, serial_0_value_0 equals the current io_0 and serial_0_value_1 equals the current io_1.
